_README: Dated exceptions to the construction gate (tools/publish_gate.py). A waiver is not a way to make
a finding quiet: every one is PRINTED on every publish run with its reason and its date. If a
reason cannot be written down, the artifact is not ready to back a public number.
Keys are repo-relative paths; 'kinds' are construction_audit.py finding kinds.
UNSWEPT-KNOB is the disclosure class: an exposed env knob the published run never varied. The
waiver must either say why the knob cannot change a measured value (an output or cache location)
or state the value the published run actually used.

research/probes/ragdead/exp_ragdead_A.py.reason: RAGDEAD_OUT names the directory the result JSON is written to. A destination cannot change a measured value; there is no other knob in this file.

research/probes/reversibility_predictabi.reason: TE_CORPUS selects the input corpus and CAN change the numbers, so it is disclosed rather than dismissed: the published run used the default, research/probes/data/toolemu_all_toolkits.json.

research/probes/locomo_retrieval_map.py.reason: Four knobs. LOCOMO_CACHE and LOCOMO_OUT are a memoisation file and an output file — neither can change a value. LOCOMO_PATH and OLLAMA_EMBED_URL can, and are disclosed: the published run used agora_output/lab/data/locomo10.json with nomic-embed-text at http://localhost:11434/api/embed.

C:/Users/Danculus/ramr-pub/ramr_trace_ex.reason: TRACES sets how many chains are exported and CAN change a measured value, so it is swept rather than dismissed: ramr_traces_knob_sweep.py runs it at 50/150/300/600 and records ramr_traces_knob_sweep_result.json. The positional invariant Marat Sultanov found is 100% at every size, so it is a property of the generator and not of the sample. The published run used TRACES=300 (the corpus holds exactly 300 chains). The sweep also found a real defect the intuition would have missed -- TRACES=600 silently produced 300 -- and the export now prints a NOTE when the corpus is exhausted.

agora_output/lab/memops/pilot.py.reason: Scoped to the ORACLE arms only (oracle_state / oracle_evidence / oracle_evidence_neutral / oracle_current), which are the arms any public number from this file cites. Those arms build their context from the probe's own gold record (ctx_oracle_* at lines 313-367) and never call recall(), so MEMOPS_TOPK -- used solely at line 206 inside m.recall(k=TOPK), and documented at line 34 as 'the retrieval depth of the turn-level arms' -- is outside their causal path. MEMOPS_CONCURRENCY is a ThreadPoolExecutor width (line 562) and changes wall-clock, not accuracy; the observable that would catch a concurrency-induced loss is dropped rows, and the run records zero drops over 216. MEMOPS_MEM0_MODEL (line 220) selects the model for the mem0 comparison arm, which is not an oracle arm. Values as run are stated beside the numbers wherever they are quoted: TOPK=20, CONCURRENCY=8, MEM0_MODEL=glm-5.2. This waiver does NOT cover the turn-level or mem0 arms -- citing those requires sweeping TOPK first.

C:/Users/Danculus/inspeximus-repo/probes.reason: OPENAI_API_KEY is a credential, not an experimental parameter: it selects WHO is billed, never what is measured, and the probe refuses with exit 2 when it is absent rather than silently producing a number. The degree of freedom this gate is right to worry about here is the JUDGE, and that one is swept explicitly -- five models, with the temperature recorded per model because two of them refuse 0.0 -- which is the subject of the probe rather than an undisclosed knob.

OPENAI_API_KEY is a credential and cannot change a measured value; the probe exits 2 without it. Every knob that CAN move the number is pinned and printed beside it: judge_model gpt-4o-mini, judge_temperature 0.0, n 20, runs 30, and the fixture is committed in the file. The whole point of the probe is that the remaining variation is the model's own non-determinism, so there is no unswept parameter left to blame.
